prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Murdle Ridgehide. Character visual motifs: squat scarred **pangolin-like** creature with detachable armored dorsal segments, clay talons and patchwork iron saddle; no Bristleback-like rear damage reduction, sticky goo or warpath attack stacks.
TOP LEFT: Plate Accounting. Ability concept: Murdle begins with 4 dorsal plates, each providing 4% damage reduction from any direction. Each deployed plate removes its personal reduction until recovered after expiration or collected. Plate inventory shown openly.
TOP RIGHT: Shed a Wall. Ability concept: detaches one plate and props it as a 40-GU breakable low wall for 4 s. It blocks one ordinary projectile from **either** team, never closes a chokepoint fully. Max two active walls.
BOTTOM LEFT: Recall Shell. Ability concept: reels one deployed plate along a visible 60-GU path back toward Murdle; units crossed are lightly nudged to nearest free ground but never stunned. Recovered plate re-enters passive armor only upon reaching Murdle; destroyer removes it until its natural recovery timer.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Fortress Migration. Ability concept: for 5 s, Murdle can redeploy up to three plates as a **moving staggered palisade** advancing 60 GU. Each plate remains individually destroyable, with gaps at least two hero diameters wide. His own armor drops dramatically while the wall travels.
